Zyra|jgl.identity: Magic damage mage who fights with plants. Rampant Growth (W) places seeds; Deadly Spines (Q) grows a plant that shoots from range, Grasping Roots (E) roots in a line and grows a plant that slows, and Stranglethorns (R) knocks up after a delay while empowering her plants. Seeds also spawn around her over time (passive).
Zyra|jgl.playstyle: Fast-clearing jungler who ganks from range. Her plants clear camps and objectives for her, and E's CC makes her ganks very reliable.
Zyra|jgl.early_game: Clear fast by placing seeds on camps and growing them with Q and E. Gank with E from a safe distance: CC, then Q and your plants. Your plants also help you duel melee junglers.
Zyra|jgl.level_1: Deadly Spines (Q) first. Place seeds and grow them on the camp.
Zyra|jgl.level_2: Rampant Growth (W). More seeds for more plants: your clear speeds up.
Zyra|jgl.level_3: Grasping Roots (E). First gank: E (CC) → Q on a seed → plants.
Zyra|jgl.level_6: Stranglethorns: an area that knocks up after a delay and empowers your plants. Cast it on several grouped enemies or on an objective to contest it.
power_spikes: Level 6: zone control with your ultimate.
Objectives: your plants clear epic monsters quickly.
Zyra|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear with your plants and ranged ganks. Zyra is very good on objectives: place seeds near Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons before fights. Control Scuttles and avoid tanky junglers who taunt you or stick to you (Rammus, Udyr).
Zyra|jgl.trading: Ganking: E → Q → plants. Teamfighting: R on several enemies, E to root, plants for damage. Give up on it against tanks who stick to you (Rammus, Udyr).
threats: Rammus and Udyr, unfavorable according to the data.
mistakes: Casting E with no seed to grow a plant.
Forgetting to place seeds before an objective.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Your plants bother him in duels: root him with E when he engages.
matchup_notes.Graves: Your plants soak his shots: fight near your seeds.
matchup_notes.Viego: Root him with E when he dives.
matchup_notes.Sylas: He can steal your ultimate: don't engage when he can take it back.
matchup_notes.Rammus: His taunt sticks to you: keep E to slow him before he arrives.

Zyra|jgl.mid_game: Objective control with your plants and ranged ganks.
Zyra|jgl.late_game: Area mage: R on several enemies, E to root, plants for damage. Stay behind your frontline.
Zyra|jgl.ahead: Take objectives quickly and force fights near your seeds.
Zyra|jgl.behind: Farm, place seeds around objectives and play with your team.
Zyra|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to control objectives with your plants and root enemies in teamfights.
Zyra|jgl.final_tip: Cast your abilities on your seeds: your plants deal most of the damage.
